ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey to black) pixels covering approximately 85-90% of the visible surface, with localized high-intensity (white/off-white) pixel clusters providing high contrast.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark field with distinct high-contrast white circular rings and solid blobs. Significant concentration of high-intensity, textured white masses on the distal tips of both lobes; scattered circular 'rosette' patterns across the medial and lateral zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 50 degrees at the vertex; depth is partially obscured by water surface spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge of both lobes, characterized by sharp pixel peaks and varying valley depths isolated against the sky background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge extending from the median notch to the distal tips; leading edges show a distinct concave sweep towards the barnacle-encrusted extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white-ring pixel clusters (likely lamprey or cookie-cutter shark scars) distributed across the ventral surface, with notable concentrations on the left-medial region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle vertical and diagonal linear disruptions in the dark pigmentation, most notably a pair of dark rake marks near the center-right of the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Massive calcareous barnacle colonies fixed to the lateral tips of both lobes, creating a rugged, high-intensity white texture that alters the natural geometric profile of the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique combination of circular white scarring and extensive tip-colonization by barnacles creating a highly distinct individual pixel signature.
